## Context

### Context

This repository contains Promptbook landing pages for different businesses,
use cases, and audiences. Keep these rules current when behavior changes.

#### Public routes

- `/` redirects to `/cs` or `/en` using `Accept-Language`.
- `/cs` is the Czech homepage and source of truth for homepage structure and copy.
- `/en` is its English localization.
- `/pro-mesta`, `/pro-firmy`, `/for-agro`, `/for-industry`, `/ai-supervize`,
  `/hackathon-factory`, and `/pavol` are specialized landing pages. `/pavol`
  redirects to `/cs/pavol` or `/en/pavol`; the localized pages are Pavol Hejny's
  personal pages.
- `/ai-supervize-mini` is the Czech one-day AI Supervize page. Published terms,
  prices, capacities, places, FAQs, registration, and participant information
  come from `/admin/workshops`; with no published term it shows a notice.
  `/skoleni` redirects there.
- `/cs/online-workshop` lists free 60-minute online workshops about writing
  production code with AI agents. Each term has its own subject and description,
  but all use one registration form. `/cs/online-workshop/dekujeme` is the
  full-load conversion page; `/participant` is the live room. Its waiting room
  offers every published term as the same term cards the landing page registers
  with: running and upcoming ones first, finished ones behind a disclosure.
  Picking one changes the room being connected to and the `workshop` parameter,
  without losing the name and e-mail already typed. Once a term has its recorded
  end, its participant wrap-up offers a locally generated PDF using only the
  attendee-visible description, key takeaways and shared materials; it creates
  no administrative setting or database record.
- `/ai-ta-krajta` reads episodes hourly from podcast RSS and YouTube feeds and
  merges their host rosters with `businesses/ai-ta-krajta/aiTaKrajtaEpisodes.json`. Its shared platform list exposes
  the publisher's direct RSS feed for custom podcast applications, and page metadata advertises it as
  `application/rss+xml`.
  Each episode lists every credited person by name, and every person any source
  credits has a card in `aiTaKrajtaPeople.ts`, which a test keeps in step, so a
  credited person never misses their portrait and the filter cannot lose them.
  It keeps exact episode counts but labels subscriptions and listening hours as
  estimates. The fixed mini-player, newest-episode header button, person/search/
  episode/play/archive/collaboration filters, and section hash are shareable as
  query/hash state; the snake game is local state. Person clicks filter episodes.
  Everyone in the roster shows a normalized, transparent PNG portrait. The source
  crop is recorded by `scripts/_cutAiTaKrajtaPeoplePortraits.mjs`, from the
  episode cover the show itself published them on or from the picture they publish
  of themselves when no cover carries them; the final alpha PNG is named by the
  roster and a test verifies its format and transparent pixels. Portrait frames
  supply subtle, stable neutral-gradient variations and a restrained hover cue,
  so photographed backgrounds never compete with the page. The one people list
  is drawn anew
  for every visit, weighted by how many episodes of the archive name each
  person, so somebody heard often comes up high far more often than someone in
  one díl without the list ever becoming a ranking. The draw is local state and
  is made in the browser; the page itself is built in the order the draw leans
  towards, from the most often named person to the least often named one, so the
  browser hydrates into the list it was sent.
  Collaboration submissions use `/admin/contacts`. Its tab icon is the page's
  own snake drawing in `/ai-ta-krajta/logo.svg` and `.png`; SVG corners are
  rounded and transparent, while the raster fills its square. That drawing is
  traced off the cover artwork of the show and recorded once in
  `businesses/ai-ta-krajta/aiTaKrajtaMarkArtwork.ts`, together with the
  measurements of the animal along its own length. The snake of the minigame
  starts in exactly that shape, in the frame the still logo occupied, and only
  then eases into the proportions, colours and speed of a game snake.
  A seven-cell Promptbook coder terminal floats in the bottom-right corner and
  clears the player and cookie controls. It types `$ ptbk`, then animates an
  ASCII octopus in response to pointer, focus, scrolling, and the snake terrarium.
  It stays still for reduced motion and pauses its clock in hidden tabs. The
  badge and the shared footer credit link to `https://coder.ptbk.io/`.
- `/ai-ta-krajta/media-kit` and `/ai-ta-krajta/branding` are the two pages beside
  the podcast. They are named once, in `AI_TA_KRAJTA_SUBPAGES`, which the footer
  lists and which they point at each other through, so no link can name a page
  differently than the page names itself. Both wear the same compact header,
  section heading and footer as each other. The brand kit hands out the logo the
  site already serves at `/ai-ta-krajta/logo.svg`, `.png` and the cover artwork,
  publishes no colour outside `AI_TA_KRAJTA_COLORS`, and says how the name is
  written; it asks for nothing and sends visitors to the media-kit form.
- `/cs/komunita` is the permanent Czech community room. It has chat, polls,
  projects, materials, and published terms, but no schedule, stage, or live
  updates. Terms show event kind, format/place, price, and status. A term with a
  live room links there; otherwise it links to its landing page. The calendar
  opens on the member's month, can filter by day, and uses the same terms and
  statuses as the cards. Empty days cannot be selected; an empty month is only
  selected when the member's month has no terms. The room offers Google Calendar
  and `webcal:` subscriptions.
- `/cs/komunita/projects` is the full project gallery, ordered by upvotes.
  `/cs/komunita/projects/<project_id>` shows scraped project details and a
  moderated discussion. Project-room sessions derive from the community session;
  the author moderates their own discussion.
- `/cs/komunita/clenstvi` offers free community access and the 199 Kč monthly
  membership. Webinars remain free; paid access adds recordings, archive,
  materials, extra content, priority questions, and Discord/community features.
  The page is prefilled from `fullname` and `email`, supports community discount
  codes, has no new annual plan or trial, and allows cancellation.
- `/cs/komunita/calendar.ics` publishes the same terms by stable slug, so moved
  or renamed terms update existing subscriptions. It contains only event terms
  and public destinations, never subscriber identity.
- `/admin/workshops` manages terms of every event kind, participants, comments,
  reactions, content, attached community polls, and settings. Every term says both
  of its audiences: the people registered on the landing page of its event, and
  the people who entered its room. A room which is no term of an event says
  nothing about registrations at all. The registration block opens the exact
  filtered `/admin/contacts` list and its shared CSV, vCard, and Book exports;
  it never creates a second contact table or serializer in workshop administration.
- `/admin/community` manages the permanent community, including polls, project
  moderation, participants, memberships, payments, and room analytics.
- `/admin/shortener` manages public short links, QR/UTM output, destinations,
  notes, search/filter/sort state, and private click history. Links are served
  by `/[shortcode]`; `/shortener` redirects to the admin page.
- `/admin/login` authenticates the single `admin` account with `ADMIN_PASSWORD`
  and a signed session cookie. All `/admin/*` pages and APIs require
  `requireAdminSignedIn`. `/admin` is the post-login dashboard.
- Other public/legal routes include `/contact`, `/data-deletion`, `/privacy`,
  `/terms`, `/dekujeme`, `/branding`, and the routes under `/k`, `/old`, and
  `/test`.

#### Shared community and workshop behavior

- Rooms lead to each other in both directions, through one identity hand-off. The
  community lists the terms and opens the room of each; an invited workshop room
  places its community link beside its materials as a special material for every
  participant, regardless of paid membership. Where a special material sits is
  decided once, in `lib/workshops/workshopSpecialMaterials.ts`: a card says where
  among the ordinary materials it belongs, and the invitation opens the material
  list of a participant who does not pay while it closes the list of a paying
  member. A membership which is not loaded yet leaves it where a participant who
  does not pay reads it. Both carry the connected member's
  name and email on, and an incomplete identity carries nothing rather than half
  of it. Which rooms invite is answered by
  `lib/workshops/workshopKindCapabilities.ts`; the community and project
  discussions do not. The invitation names the community's sections by the names
  the community itself uses.
- Community polls attached to workshops are shared. A normalized email gives a
  member one vote across the community and all attached workshops. An
  administrator can enable an Other answer: a member-written response becomes
  one shared, anonymous option and receives that member's vote atomically, so
  every room can vote for it; later poll edits keep member-written answers.
  Workshops may display and accept votes, but the community owns administration.
- The participant room owns the membership badge and popup. Community and live
  workshop rooms use the same membership for the connecting email, and checkout
  returns to the room where it started. Membership is offered only by room kinds
  listed in `lib/workshops/workshopKindCapabilities.ts`; project discussions do
  not offer it.
- Members can open Stripe Customer Portal from the popup. In-app cancellation
  stops only the next renewal, preserves access through the paid period, appears
  in the badge, and can be reversed before that period ends.
- A full-price-for-the-whole-term discount is a voucher: atomically consume it,
  create membership immediately, ask for no card, and create no Stripe renewal.
  A limited-month discount still opens checkout because the regular price returns.
  Stripe webhooks update completed, cancelled, failed, and late payments. With no
  Stripe key, hide membership; with test keys, identify the test payment gate.
- Community projects use a URL-first metadata wizard. Ordinary submissions await
  moderation; trusted members and moderators are approved immediately. Pending
  projects remain visible to their author and moderators.
- A live workshop room has countdown, YouTube stage, reactions, watching count,
  moderated chat, timed materials, and attached poll aggregates. An open-ended
  term runs until its recorded end; its stage does not end automatically. Admins
  can select, replace, clear, or create the displayed comment through the same
  private realtime channel used by reactions.
- A term can be about a project. The connection is one value — GitHub repository,
  the default branch, and one or more branch patterns such as `main`, `client-*`,
  `feature/*`, or `*` for all branches, plus an optional deployment URL — so it is
  set, changed, and unset at once and neither branch selection nor deployment
  outlives its repository. Room kinds which offer it are named in
  `lib/workshops/workshopKindCapabilities.ts`. The room shows the repository as a
  special material beside its ordinary materials for every participant, with its
  links and newest commits, marking those which arrive while a participant watches;
  a newly found commit is broadcast to active rooms and appears on the stage for
  ten seconds. A selection resolving to multiple branches is shown as a commit
  graph. Commits come from the public commit feed or keyless API, pooled once per
  server and cached through the revalidation window; an unreadable feed still
  leaves the room naming its project.
- A workshop can carry one public presentation URL for a PDF, PowerPoint file, or
  GitHub Markdown page. The room renders it beside ordinary materials through the
  shared material card, primary action, and QR code, for every participant without
  making it timed or membership-gated content.
- Paid-only materials are decided on the server in one pass. Members receive
  unlocked material; others receive only the published titles as an offer. An
  untitled item is not named, items are not named before their unlock time, and a
  room without membership hides paid-only items without naming them.
- After a workshop ends, its recording is server-gated to members. Others receive
  the published teaser, or a generic offer when no teaser exists; a term without
  a recording offers nothing. An administrator can set the recording's start
  offset in seconds, which applies only to that paid replay and never to the
  countdown or live stream.
- Trusted participants remain invisible and their messages are auto-approved.
  Moderators see pending messages, can approve/reject/correct/pin them, and can
  trust or silence authors. Workshop and community moderators are appointed in
  `/admin/workshops`; project authors moderate their own discussions.
- The room records whether each open browser is actively or passively attended
  from pointer, typing, scroll, and touch activity. Admin analytics distinguish
  active computer users from merely open tabs with dashed audience lines.
- The community's compact gallery shows its five highest-upvoted approved projects
  and links to the full gallery. Community landing content is read from the live
  room: expose only anonymous totals, approved messages, and shared projects;
  show member first names only. If the room cannot be read, show less content,
  not an error. Landing-page reactions are estimates based on recent room data.

#### Administration and data rules

- Event kinds are defined once in `lib/events/eventTypes.ts`; adding one should
  not require database migration or page-specific duplication. Terms ask for kind,
  online/place format, price, and capacity. Each kind also names where its landing
  page records registrations, which is the `placeName` of the contacts it gathers.
- Which term a registration belongs to is decided once, in
  `lib/workshops/workshopRegistrations.ts`. A term is recognised by its slug, by
  its Prague day, and by the moment it begins at, so registrations written before
  terms had slugs keep counting. Registration forms write the term through the
  same line prefixes that rule reads back. Contacts are still gathered, recorded
  and shown only by `/admin/contacts`; counting reads nothing but their notes.
  The registration actions in workshop administration carry that same term filter
  into the contacts list and its exports.
- Workshop polls are read-only in workshop administration. Creating a new event
  publishes it by default; duplicating an event keeps it published unless the
  source is unpublished. Duplicating a workshop preserves its connections to
  the already existing attached polls; it creates no polls, options, votes, or room history. Stage settings contain
  the live stream, paid-recording start offset, and recording teaser; presentation settings the public presentation
  address, and project settings the repository the term is about, written as an
  address or as `owner/name`, together with its branch patterns. Deleting a workshop is a soft deletion: its room
  data and attached
  community polls stay stored, but the term leaves normal public and administrative
  lists and no longer holds its slug for a replacement. An end may be empty;
  admins can record, adjust, clear, and reopen it. Overview analytics are zoomable and share their
  room, section, lines, reaction, zoom, and keyword metrics through query params.
- Community administration is the workshop dashboard restricted to the
  `community` room kind: no room picker, schedule, stage, reactions, or address.
  Its membership view filters Stripe lifecycle, prices, discounts, identifiers,
  dates, test/live mode, and links to the exact Stripe checkout/subscription.
  Community analytics cover all measured time and member details show seen times.
- Shortener search, provenance filters, sorting, and selected click history live
  in GET parameters. Editing changes only shortcode, destinations, note, and
  landing page; deletion also deletes recorded clicks.

#### Database and verification

- Put database changes in `migrations/*.sql`. Startup and
  `npm run migrate-database` run `_initialize.sql`, then migrations in filename
  order, recording immutable filenames and checksums in `public."Migration"`.
  Changed or missing migrations fail, as do queries requiring an unapplied one.
- `npm run test-types` must build before `tsc` to refresh `.next/types`.
- `npm run test-e2e` uses the Next.js development server; first-request compile
  headroom belongs in `playwright.config.ts`, not individual tests. E2E tests are
  independent and each archives one recording in `tests/e2e/videos/`, retaining
  only recent runs.

from '@/lib/events/eventPrice';\nimport {\n    formatCzechWorkshopDay,\n    formatCzechWorkshopDayAndMonth,\n    formatCzechWorkshopTimeRange,\n} from '@/lib/workshops/workshopDate';\n\nconst EVENT_DETAIL_SEPARATOR = ' · ';\nconst EVENT_DAY_SEPARATOR = ' / ';\nconst EVENT_LOCATION_SEPARATOR = ' i ';\n\n/**\n * The same values in the order they were first written, so a summary never repeats * The days a set of terms is held on, for example `4. 9. / 9. 9. / 18. 9.`\n */\nexport function formatEventOccurrenceDaySummary(occurrences: readonly EventOccurrence[]): string {\n    return selectDistinctValues(\n        occurrences.map((occurrence) => formatCzechWorkshopDayAndMonth(occurrence.startsAt)),\n    ).join(EVENT_DAY_SEPARATOR);\n}\n\n/**\n * Where a set of terms is held, for formatEventListingDateTime(startsAt: string, locale: string, timeZone: string): string {\n    const startsAtDate = new Date(startsAt);\n    const dateLabel = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, {\n        weekday: 'long',\n        day: 'numeric',\n        month: 'numeric',\n        year: 'numeric',\n        timeZone,\n    }).format(startsAtDate);\n    const timeLabel = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale, { text-slate-100\">{connectionDetails.durationLabel}</dd>\n                        </div>\n                    </dl>\n                </section>\n\n                <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className=\"p-6 sm:p-8 md:p-10\">\n                    <div className=\"flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-cyan-300/10 text-cyan-200\">\n                        <LockKeyhole className=\"h-5 w-5\" />\n                    </div>\n                    <h2 className=\"mt-5 text-2xl font-bold sm:text-3xl\">{connectionHeading}</h2>\n                    <p className=\"mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-400\">{connectionDescription}</p>\n\n                    <div className=\"mt-7 space-y-5\">\n                        <div>\n                            <label htmlFor=\"participant-fullname\" className=\"text-sm font-medium text-slate-200\">\n                                Jméno a příjmení\n                            </label>\n                            <Input\n                                id=\"participant-fullname\"\n                                value={fullname}\n                                onChange={(event) => setFullname(event.target.value)}\n                                autoComplete=\"name\"\n                                maxLength={MAXIMAL_WORKSHOP_PARTICIPANT_FULLNAME_LENGTH}\n                                required\n                                placeholder=\"Jana Nováková\"\n                                className=\"mt-2 h-11 border-white/15 bg-white/5 text-white placeholder:text-slate-600\"\n                                aria-invalid={isValidationVisible && !isFullnameValid}\n                            />\n                            {isValidationVisible && !isFullnameValid && (\n                                <p className=\"mt-1 text-xs text-rose-300\">Vyplňte prosím své jméno.</p>\n                            )}\n                        </div>\n                        <div>\n                            <label htmlFor=\"participant-email\" className=\"text-sm font-medium text-slate-200\">\n                                E-mail\n                            </label>\n                            <Input\n                                id=\"participant-email\"\n                                type=\"email\"\n                                value={email}\n                                onChange={(event) => setEmail(event.target.value)}\n                                autoComplete=\"email\"\n                                maxLength={MAXIMAL_WORKSHOP_PARTICIPANT_EMAIL_LENGTH}\n                                required\n                                placeholder=\"jmeno@firma.cz\"\n                                className=\"mt-2 h-11 border-white/15 bg-white/5 text-white placeholder:text-slate-600\"\n                                aria-invalid={isValidationVisible && !isEmailValid}\n                            />\n                            {isValidationVisible && !isEmailValid && (\n                                <p className=\"mt-1 text-xs text-rose-300\">Zadejte platný e-mail.</p>\n                            )}\n                        </div>\n                    </div>\n\n                    {errorMessage && (\n                        <p className=\"mt-5 break-words rounded-lg border border-rose-400/20 bg-rose-400/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-rose-200\">\n                            {errorMessage}\n                        </p>\n                    )}\n\n                    <Button\n                        type=\"submit\"\n                        disabled={isSubmitting}\n                        className=\"mt-6 h-12 w-full rounded-full bg-cyan-300 text-base font-bold text-slate-950 hover:bg-cyan-200\"\n                    >\n                        {isSubmitting ? (\n                            'Připojuji…'\n                        ) : (\n                            <>\n                                {submitLabel} <ArrowRight className=\"ml-2 h-4 w-4\" />\n                            </>\n                        )}\n                    </Button>\n                    <PersonalDataConsentNote\n                        language={connectionDetails.language ?? what runs now, what comes next, then the history\n *\n * Note: A term the application cannot lead anywhere is deliberately left out instead of being offered as a link which\n *       would open a different event.\n */\nexport function createEventListings({\n    workshops,\n    participantIdentity,\n    currentTimeMilliseconds,\n    timeZone,\n}: EventListingOptions): readonly EventListing[] {\n    return sortWorkshopsByPhase(workshops, currentTimeMilliseconds).flatMap((workshop) => {\n        const link = createEventLinkOrNull(workshop, participantIdentity);\n\n        return link === null || workshop.event === null\n            ? []\n            : [\n                  {\n                      workshop,\n                      event: workshop.event,\n                      link,\n                      phase: getWorkshopPhase(workshop, currentTimeMilliseconds),\n                      dayKey: createCalendarDayKey(workshop.startsAt, timeZone),\n                  },\n              ];\n    });\n}\n\n/**\n * The listed terms of every day which has any, so that a calendar reads the terms of one day without searching all of\n * them again for every day it draws\n */\nexport function groupEventListingsByDayKey(\n    listings: readonly EventListing[],\n): ReadonlyMap<CalendarDayKey, readonly EventListing[]> {\n    const listingsByDayKey = new Map<CalendarDayKey, EventListing[]>();\n\n    for (const listing of listings) {\n        const dayListings = listingsByDayKey.get(listing.dayKey);\n        if (dayListings === undefined) {\n            listingsByDayKey.set(listing.dayKey, [listing]);\n        } else {\n            dayListings.push(listing);\n        }\n    }\n\n    return listingsByDayKey;\n}\n\n/**\n * The month a calendar of these terms opens on\n *\n * Note: A calendar opens on the month a member is in, because that is the month they are looking for. Only when\n *       nothing at all is listed in it does it open on the month of the most relevant term instead, so that a member\n *       is never met by an empty grid while terms are waiting one page away.\n */\nexport function selectInitialCalendarMonthKey(\n    listings: readonly EventListing[],\n    todayDayKey: CalendarDayKey,\n): CalendarMonthKey {\n    const currentMonthKey = getCalendarMonthKey(todayDayKey);\n    const isAnyListingInCurrentMonth = listings.some(\n        (listing) => getCalendarMonthKey(listing.dayKey) === currentMonthKey,\n    );\n\n    if (isAnyListingInCurrentMonth || listings.length === 0) {\n        return currentMonthKey;\n    }\n\n    return getCalendarMonthKey(listings[0].dayKey);\n}\n","numLines":130,"startLine":1,"totalLines":130}}}

mainContentAfterWorkshopNavigation,\n133\t    isMaterialsShown = true,\n134\t    connectionRequiredContent,\n135\t    connectionTermPicker,\n136\t}: OnlineWorkshopParticipantPageProps) {\n137\t                onClick={() => void controller.refresh()}\n                                className=\"shrink-0 font-semibold underline underline-offset-4\"\n                            >\n                                Zkusit znovu\n                            </button>\n                        </div>\n                    ) : null}\n\n                    {roomCapabilities.isStageOffered && (\n                        <WorkshopStage\n                            workshop={state.workshop}\n                            serverTime={state.serverTime}\n                            subscribeToReactions={controller.subscribeToReactions}\n                            repository={state.workshop.repository}\n                            subscribeToRepositoryCommits={subscribeToRepositoryCommits}\n                            feedback={state.feedback}\n                            contentBlocks={state.contentBlocks}\n                            followUpContentBlock={followUpContentBlock}\n                            stageComment={state.stageComment}\n                            paidMembersOnlyVideo={state.paidMembersOnlyVideo}\n                            onSaveFeedback={controller.saveFeedback}\n                        />\n                    )}\n                    {calendarDetails !== null && (\n                        <WorkshopCalendarInvitation\n                            workshop={state.workshop}\n                            serverTime={state.serverTime}\n                            hostFullname={calendarDetails.hostFullname}\n                            participantPath={calendarDetails.participantPath}\n                            participantIdentity={state.participant}\n                        />\n                    )}\n                    {pollsBeforeMaterials}\n                    {workshopNavigation !== undefined && (\n                        <WorkshopLinksPanel\n                            workshops={workshopNavigation.workshops}\n                            participantIdentity={state.participant}\n                            title={workshopNavigation.title}\n                            description={workshopNavigation.description}\n                            emptyMessage={workshopNavigation.emptyMessage}\n                            locale={workshopNavigation.locale}\n                            timeZone={workshopNavigation.timeZone}\n                            serverTime={state.serverTime}\n                            calendarFeedUrl={workshopNavigation.calendarFeedUrl}\n                        />\n                    )}\n                    {mainContentAfterWorkshopNavigation}\n                    {isPanelOffered('reactions') && (\n                        <WorkshopReactions\n                            emojis={state.workshop.allowedReactions}\n                            reactionCounts={state.reactionCounts}\n                            isInteractionBanned={state.participant.isInteractionBanned}\n                            onReact={controller.react}\n                        />\n                    )}\n                </div>\n\n                <WorkshopChat\n                    className=\"min-w-0 lg:col-start-2 lg:row-span-2 lg:row-start-1\"\n                    comments={state.comments}\n                    commentSort={controller.commentSort}\n                    isEnabled={isPanelOffered('chat')}\n                    isInteractionBanned={state.participant.isInteractionBanned}\n                    isModerating={isModerating}\n                    onChangeSort={controller.changeCommentSort}\n                    onSubmitComment={controller.submitComment}\n                    onUpvoteComment={controller.upvoteComment}\n                    onModerateComment={controller.moderateComment}\n                    onModerateAuthor={controller.moderateAuthor}\n                />\n\n                {/*\n                  * Note: What the room hands over and the polls it closes with share one cell of the layout, so a\n                  *       poll always follows the materials directly instead of an empty row being kept for a room\n                  *       which shows one of the two.\n                  */}\n                {(isMaterialsShown || pollsAfterMaterials !== null) && (\n                    <div className=\"min-w-0 lg:col-start-1 lg:row-start-2\">\n                        {isMaterialsShown && (\n                            <WorkshopContent\n                                contentBlocks={state.contentBlocks}\n                                nextContentUnlockAt={state.nextContentUnlockAt}\n                                newlyUnlockedContentBlockIds={controller.newlyUnlockedContentBlockIds}\n                                paidMembersOnlyContentPreviews={state.paidMembersOnlyContentPreviews}\n                                specialMaterials={specialMaterials}\n                                title={materialsTitle}\n                            />\n                        )}\n                        {pollsAfterMaterials}\n                    </div>\n                )}\n            </main>\n        </div>\n    );\n\n    /*\n     * Note: The membership of a member is one membership wherever they read it from, and every surface of the room\n     *       which needs to know it — the badge and the modal in the header, the paid materials and the video which a\n     *       paid member unlocks after the workshop — asks this one controller instead of loading a membership of its\n     *       own.\n     */\n    return (\n        <CommunityMembershipRoomProvider\n            workshopSlug={workshopSlug}\n            isMembershipOffered={roomCapabilities.isMembershipOffered}\n        >\n            {roomLayout}\n        </CommunityMembershipRoomProvider>\n    );\n}\n","numLines":464,"startLine":1,"totalLines":464}}}

client';\n\nimport {\n    ONLINE_WORKSHOP_HOST_FULLNAME,\n    ONLINE_WORKSHOP_PARTICIPANT_PATH,\n} from '@/businesses/online-workshop/config';\nimport { createOnlineWorkshopConnectionDetails } from '@/businesses/online-workshop/onlineWorkshopTerms';\nimport { OnlineWorkshopParticipantPage } from '@/businesses/online-workshop/participant/OnlineWorkshopParticipantPage';\nimport { OnlineWorkshopRoomTermPicker } from '@/businesses/online-workshop/participant/OnlineWorkshopRoomTermPicker';\nimport type { EventOccurrence } from '@/lib/events/eventOccurrence';\nimport { createWorkshopSelectionPath } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopParticipantLink';\nimport type { WorkshopSummary } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopTypes';\nimport { useState } from 'react';\n\n/**\n * How many terms it takes for a participant to be offered a choice at all\n *\n * Note: One term is no choice, and a room which offers a list of exactly the workshop it already describes would only\n *       ask a participant to confirm what they have been told.\n */\nconst MINIMAL_PICKED_ONLINE_WORKSHOP_COUNT = 2;\n\ntype OnlineWorkshopSelectedTermRoomProps = {\n    /**\n     * The term this address opened, which is the one a participant connects to unless they pick another\n     */\n    readonly openedWorkshop: WorkshopSummary;\n\n    /**\n     * Every published term of the online workshop, which is what a participant picks from\n     */\n    readonly workshops: readonly EventOccurrence[];\n\n    /**\n     * Moment the server built this page at, which places every offered term in time\n     */\n    readonly currentTime: string;\n    readonly initialEmail: string;\n    readonly initialFullname: string;\n};\n\n/**\n * Keeps the address of the room on the term which is really being entered, so reloading the waiting room or sharing\n * its address opens the workshop a participant picked rather than the one they were offered first.\n */\nfunction rememberPickedWorkshopInAddress(workshopSlug: string): void {\n    const roomPath = `${window.location.pathname}${window.location.search}${window.location.hash}`;\n    window.history.replaceState(window.history.state, '', createWorkshopSelectionPath(roomPath, workshopSlug));\n}\n\n/**\n * The room of one term of the online workshop, together with the choice of which term that is\n *\n * Note: The choice lives here rather than in the shared room, because only this business surface knows which terms\n *       belong to the online workshop. The room below is the very same audited participant room every other kind of\n *       event uses.\n */\nexport function OnlineWorkshopSelectedTermRoom({\n    openedWorkshop,\n    workshops,\n    currentTime,\n    initialEmail,\n    initialFullname,\n}: OnlineWorkshopSelectedTermRoomProps) {\n    const [pickedWorkshopSlug, setPickedWorkshopSlug] = useState(openedWorkshop.slug);\n\n    // Note: A term which is not among the published ones leaves the room exactly where the address put it, so an\n    //       address opening a term this list does not carry still enters that very term.\n    const selectedWorkshop =\n        workshops.find((workshop) => workshop.slug === pickedWorkshopSlug) ?? openedWorkshop;\n    const isChoiceOffered = workshops.length >= MINIMAL_PICKED_ONLINE_WORKSHOP_COUNT;\n\n    const pickWorkshop = (workshop: EventOccurrence) => {\n        setPickedWorkshopSlug(workshop.slug);\n        rememberPickedWorkshopInAddress(workshop.slug);\n    };\n\n    return (\n        <OnlineWorkshopParticipantPage\n            workshopSlug={selectedWorkshop.slug}\n            connectionDetails={createOnlineWorkshopConnectionDetails(selectedWorkshop)}\n            calendarDetails={{\n                hostFullname: ONLINE_WORKSHOP_HOST_FULLNAME,\n                participantPath: ONLINE_WORKSHOP_PARTICIPANT_PATH,\n            }}\n            initialEmail={initialEmail}\n            initialFullname={initialFullname}\n            connectionTermPicker={\n                isChoiceOffered ? (\n                    <OnlineWorkshopRoomTermPicker\n                        terms={workshops}\n                        selectedTermSlug={selectedWorkshop.slug}\n                        onSelectTerm={pickWorkshop}\n                        currentTime={currentTime}\n                    />\n                ) : undefined\n            }\n        />\n    );\n}\n","numLines":101,"startLine":1,"totalLines":101}}}

null : 'Vyplňte jméno a příjmení.',\n36\t        emailError: email.trim()\n37\t            ? isEmailAddressValid(email)\n38\t                ? null\n39\t                : 'Zadejte prosím platný e-mail.'\n40\t            : 'Vyplňte e-mail.',\n41\t    };\n42\t}\n43\t\n44\t/**\n45\t * Note: The term is named on the very lines the administration counts the people registered for it from, so the note a\n46\t *       registration is written with and the note that count is read from can never drift apart.\n47\t */\n48\tfunction createOnlineWorkshopRegistrationNote(workshop: EventOccurrence): string {\n49\t    return [\n50\t        'Online workshop registration',\n51\t        `Workshop: ${workshop.title}`,\n52\t        `${REGISTRATION_TERM_SLUG_LINE_PREFIX} ${workshop.slug}`,\n53\t        `${REGISTRATION_TERM_MOMENT_LINE_PREFIX} ${formatCzechWorkshopMoment(workshop.startsAt)}`,\n54\t    ].join('\\n');\n55\t}\n56\t\n57\ttype OnlineWorkshopRegistrationFormProps = {\n58\t    /**\n59\t     * The published terms a visitor can choose from. One form deliberately serves all of them, so a person never has\n60\t     * to retype their contact details just to choose another date.\n61\t     */\n62\t    readonly workshops: readonly EventOccurrence[];\n63\t};\n64\t\n65\ttype OnlineWorkshopTermPickerProps = {\n66\t    readonly workshops: readonly EventOccurrence[];\n67\t    readonly selectedWorkshop: EventOccurrence;\n68\t    readonly onSelectWorkshop: (workshop: EventOccurrence) => void;\n69\t};\n70\t\n71\t/**\n72\t * Lets a visitor select one online-workshop occurrence without owning any registration-field state.\n73\t *\n74\t * Note: Every term of this event is a workshop about something of its own, so each card names its subject and says\n75\t *       what it is about rather than leaving a visitor to choose between dates alone.\n76\t */\n77\tfunction OnlineWorkshopTermPicker({ workshops, selectedWorkshop, onSelectWorkshop }: OnlineWorkshopTermPickerProps) {\n78\t    return (\n79\t        <fieldset>\n80\t            <legend className=\"text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700\">Vyber termín workshopu</legend>\n81\t            <EventTermOptionList\n82\t                terms={workshops}\n83\t                selectedTermSlug={selectedWorkshop.slug}\n84\t                onSelectTerm={onSelectWorkshop}\n85\t                isTopicShown={true}\n86\t                noteIcon={Clock}\n87\t                createNoteText={createOnlineWorkshopTermNoteText}\n88\t                className=\"mt-3\"\n89\t            />\n90\t        </fieldset>\n91\t    );\n92\t}\n93\t\n94\tfunction OnlineWorkshopNoTermNotice() {\n95\t    return (\n96\t        <div className=\"rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-white p-8 text-center text-slate-600 shadow-xl\">\n97\t            Zatím není vypsaný další termín. Sleduj Promptbook, nový workshop sem přidáme hned po zveřejnění.\n98\t        </div>\n99\t    );\n100\t}\n101\t\n102\texport function OnlineWorkshopRegistrationForm({ workshops }: OnlineWorkshopRegistrationFormProps) {\n103\t    const [firstWorkshop] = workshops;\n104\t\n105\t    if (firstWorkshop === undefined) {\n106\t        return <OnlineWorkshopNoTermNotice />;\n107\t    }\n108\t\n109\t    return <OnlineWorkshopSelectedTermRegistrationForm workshops={workshops} firstWorkshop={firstWorkshop} />;\n110\t}\n111\t\n112\ttype OnlineWorkshopSelectedTermRegistrationFormProps = {\n113\t    readonly workshops: readonly EventOccurrence[];\n114\t    readonly firstWorkshop: EventOccurrence;\n115\t};\n116\t\n117\t/**\n118\t * The one registration form shared by every published {\n124\t    const [selectedWorkshopSlug, setSelectedWorkshopSlug] = useState(firstWorkshop.slug);\n125\t    const [fullname, setFullname] = useState('');\n126\t    const [email, setEmail] = const handleSubmit = async (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {\n147\t        event.preventDefault();\n148\t\n149\t        if (!isSubmissionAllowed) {\n150\t `${REGISTRATION_TERM_SLUG_LINE_PREFIX} ${workshop.slug}`,\n        `${REGISTRATION_TERM_MOMENT_LINE_PREFIX} ${formatCzechWorkshopMoment(workshop.startsAt)}`,\n    ].join('\\n');\n}\n\ntype OnlineWorkshopRegistrationFormProps = {\n    /**\n     * The published terms a visitor can choose from. Sleduj Promptbook, nový workshop sem přidáme hned po zveřejnění.\n        </div>\n    );\n}\n\nexport function OnlineWorkshopRegistrationForm({ workshops }: OnlineWorkshopRegistrationFormProps) {\n    const [firstWorkshop] = workshops;\n\n    if (firstWorkshop === undefined) {\n        return <OnlineWorkshopNoTermNotice />;\n    }\n\n    return <OnlineWorkshopSelectedTermRegistrationForm firstWorkshop,\n}: OnlineWorkshopSelectedTermRegistrationFormProps) {\n    const [selectedWorkshopSlug, setSelectedWorkshopSlug] = useState(firstWorkshop.slug);\n    const [fullname, setFullname] = FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {\n        event.preventDefault();\n\n        if (!isSubmissionAllowed) {\n            setIsValidationShown(true);\n            setErrorMessage('Vyplň jméno a platný e-mail.');\n            return;\n        }\n\n        setIsValidationShown(false);\n        setIsSubmitting(true);\n        setErrorMessage(null);\n        const registrationAtMilliseconds = ONLINE_WORKSHOP_REGISTRATION_PLACE_NAME,\n                note: createOnlineWorkshopRegistrationNote(selectedWorkshop),\n            });\n\n            // Note: A full page load, not a client side route change - only that runs the Meta Pixel again and reports\n            //       a `PageView` of the thank you url, which is what the ad campaign optimizes on.\n            //       `isSubmitting` intentionally stays `true`, so the form cannot be sent twice while the browser\n            //       is still loading the thank you page.\n            window.location.assign(\n                createWorkshopRegistrationThankYouPath({\n                    thankYouPath: ONLINE_WORKSHOP_THANK_YOU_PATH,\n                    workshopSlug: selectedWorkshop.slug,\n                    startsAt: selectedWorkshop.startsAt,\n                    participantIdentity: { email, fullname },\n                    registrationAtMilliseconds,\n                }),\n            );\n        } catch (error) {\n            setErrorMessage(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Registraci se nepodařilo odeslat. Zkus to znovu.');\n            setIsSubmitting(false);\n        }\n    };\n\n    return (\n        <form\n            onSubmit={handleSubmit}\n            className=\"space-y-6 rounded-2xl border       <p className=\"text-sm font-semibold uppercase text-cyan-700\">Registrace</p>\n                    <h3 className=\"mt-2 text-2xl font-bold text-slate-950\">Vyber si termín</h3>\n aria-live=\"polite\">\n                <span className=\"flex shrink-0\">\n                    <Image\n                        src={pavolHejny}\n                        alt=\"Pavol Hejný\"\n             <Image\n                        src={jiriJahn}\n                        alt=\"Jiří Jahn\"\n                        width={44}\n                        height={44}\n    id={`${fieldIdPrefix}-fullname`}\n                        name=\"fullname\"\n                        value={fullname}\n                        onChange={(event) => setFullname(event.target.value)}\n                        placeholder=\"Jana Nováková\"\n                        autoComplete=\"name\"\n                        aria-invalid={isValidationShown && !!fullnameError}\n                        className={cn(\n                            'mt-2 h-11',\n                            isValidationShown &&\n                                fullnameError &&\n                                'border-red-300 bg-red-50/70 focus-visible:ring-red-200',\n                        )}\n                    />\n                    {isValidationShown && fullnameError && {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_018QZR4yiFiDuFERpjYSMUwR","type":"tool_result","content":"1\timport {\n2\t    CZECH_COMMUNITY_ROOM_COPY,\n3\t    CZECH_COMMUNITY_WORKSHOP_NAVIGATION_COPY,\n4\t    createCzechCommunityConnectionDetails,\n5\t} from '@/businesses/community/communityContent';\n6\timport { CommunityProjectsSection } from '@/businesses/community/projects/CommunityProjectsSection';\n7\timport { OnlineWorkshopParticipantPage } from '@/businesses/online-workshop/participant/OnlineWorkshopParticipantPage';\n8\timport type { WorkshopDetails, WorkshopSummary } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopTypes';\n9\t\n10\ttype CommunityParticipantPageProps = {\n11\t    readonly community: WorkshopDetails;\n12\t    readonly workshops: readonly WorkshopSummary[];\n13\t    readonly initialEmail: string;\n14\t    readonly initialFullname: string;\n15\t};\n16\t\n17\t/**\n18\t * Community-specific data and Czech copy on top of the shared participant room. The room itself remains the same\n19\t * audited workshop infrastructure rather than a parallel implementation, while the `community` kind of the room takes\n20\t * away what only a live occurrence has: its stage, its schedule, and its live updates.\n21\t *\n22\t * Note: The membership of the member is shown, bought and managed by the shared room itself, so the community adds\n23\t *       nothing of its own for it and reads exactly the same membership as every other room which offers it.\n24\t */\n25\texport function CommunityParticipantPage({\n26\t    community,\n27\t    workshops,\n28\t    initialEmail,\n29\t    initialFullname,\n30\t}: CommunityParticipantPageProps) {\n31\t    return (\n32\t        <OnlineWorkshopParticipantPage\n33\t            workshopSlug={community.slug}\n34\t            connectionDetails={createCzechCommunityConnectionDetails(community)}\n35\t            calendarDetails={null}\n36\t            initialEmail={initialEmail}\n37\t            initialFullname={initialFullname}\n38\t            roomSubtitle={CZECH_COMMUNITY_ROOM_COPY.roomSubtitle}\n39\t {\n    CZECH_COMMUNITY_ROOM_COPY,\n    CZECH_COMMUNITY_WORKSHOP_NAVIGATION_COPY,\n    createCzechCommunityConnectionDetails,\n} from '@/businesses/community/communityContent';\nimport { CommunityProjectsSection } from '@/businesses/community/projects/CommunityProjectsSection';\nimport { OnlineWorkshopParticipantPage } from '@/businesses/online-workshop/participant/OnlineWorkshopParticipantPage';\nimport type { WorkshopDetails, WorkshopSummary } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopTypes';\n\ntype CommunityParticipantPageProps = {\n    readonly community: WorkshopDetails;\n    readonly workshops: readonly WorkshopSummary[];\n    readonly initialEmail: string;\n    readonly initialFullname: string;\n};\n\n/**\n * Community-specific data and Czech copy on top of the shared participant room. The room itself remains the same\n * audited workshop infrastructure rather than a parallel implementation, while the `community` kind of the room takes\n * away what only a live occurrence has: its stage, its schedule, and its live updates.\n *\n * Note: The membership of the member is shown, bought and managed by the shared room itself, so the community adds\n *       nothing of its own for it and reads exactly the same membership as every other room which offers it.\n */\nexport function CommunityParticipantPage({\n    community,\n    workshops,\n    initialEmail,\n    initialFullname,\n}: CommunityParticipantPageProps) {\n    return (\n        <OnlineWorkshopParticipantPage\n            workshopSlug={community.slug}\n            connectionDetails={createCzechCommunityConnectionDetails(community)}\n            calendarDetails={null}\n            initialEmail={initialEmail}\n            initialFullname={initialFullname}\n            roomSubtitle={CZECH_COMMUNITY_ROOM_COPY.roomSubtitle}\n            isWorkshopSelectionInUrl={false}\n            materialsTitle={CZECH_COMMUNITY_ROOM_COPY.materialsTitle}\n            unavailableConnectionMessage={CZECH_COMMUNITY_ROOM_COPY.unavailableConnectionMessage}\n            workshopNavigation={{\n                workshops,\n                ...CZECH_COMMUNITY_WORKSHOP_NAVIGATION_COPY,\n            }}\n            mainContentAfterWorkshopNavigation={<CommunityProjectsSection isLimited />}\n        />\n    );\n}\n","numLines":50,"startLine":1,"totalLines":50}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01BY3yYGeZzYSJBhbJr3NJZa","type":"tool_result","content":"1\timport { WorkshopEventCard } from '@/components/workshops/WorkshopEventCard';\n2\timport { classNames } from '@/lib/classNames';\n3\timport type { EventListing } from '@/lib/events/eventListing';\n4\t\n5\t/**\n6\t * How the list of terms is named to somebody who cannot see that it is a list of them\n7\t */\n8\tconst WORKSHOP_EVENT_CARD_LIST_LABEL = 'Termíny akcí';\n9\t\n10\ttype WorkshopEventCardListProps = {\n11\t    readonly listings: readonly EventListing[];\n12\t    readonly locale: string;\n13\t    readonly timeZone: string;\n14\t    readonly className?: string;\n15\t};\n16\t\n17\t/**\n18\t * The listed terms as cards leading to them\n19\t *\n20\t * Note: Both views of the terms end in this one list - the cards show every term with it, and the calendar shows the\n21\t *       terms of the chosen day or month with it - so a term is never described in two different ways.\n22\t */\n23\texport function WorkshopEventCardList({ listings, locale, timeZone, className }: WorkshopEventCardListProps) {\n24\t    return (\n25\t        <ul aria-label={WORKSHOP_EVENT_CARD_LIST_LABEL} className={classNames('grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2', className)}>\n26\t            {listings.map((listing) => (\n27\t                <li key={listing.workshop.id}>\n28\t                    <WorkshopEventCard listing={listing} locale={locale} timeZone={timeZone} />\n29\t                </li>\n30\t            ))}\n31\t        </ul>\n32\t    );\n33\t}\n34\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d11f6467-1a05-4b7d-b399-253646a5c467","uuid":"8d6e8ae0-a1e9-429c-b3aa-eaef9b1dc662","timestamp":"2026-09-16T11:07:23.614Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\me\\work\\promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages\\aldaron\\components\\workshops\\WorkshopEventCardList.tsx","content":"import { WorkshopEventCard } from '@/components/workshops/WorkshopEventCard';\nimport { classNames } from '@/lib/classNames';\nimport type { EventListing } from '@/lib/events/eventListing';\n\n/**\n * How the list of terms is named to somebody who cannot see that it is a list of them\n */\nconst WORKSHOP_EVENT_CARD_LIST_LABEL = 'Termíny akcí';\n\ntype WorkshopEventCardListProps = {\n    readonly listings: readonly EventListing[];\n    readonly locale: string;\n    readonly timeZone: string;\n    readonly className?: string;\n};\n\n/**\n * The listed terms as cards leading to them\n *\n * Note: Both views of the terms end in this one list - the cards show every term with it, and the calendar shows the\n *       terms of the chosen day or month with it - so a term is never described in two different ways.\n */\nexport function WorkshopEventCardList({ listings, locale, timeZone, className }: WorkshopEventCardListProps) {\n    return (\n        <ul aria-label={WORKSHOP_EVENT_CARD_LIST_LABEL} className={classNames('grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2', className)}>\n            {listings.map((listing) => (\n                <li key={listing.workshop.id}>\n                    <WorkshopEventCard listing={listing} locale={locale} timeZone={timeZone} />\n                </li>\n            ))}\n        </ul>\n    );\n}\n","numLines":34,"startLine":1,"totalLines":34}}}

{weekDayLabels.map((weekDayLabel) => (\n                    <span key={weekDayLabel}>{weekDayLabel}</span>\n                ))}\n            </div>\n\n            <div className=\"mt-1 grid []}\n                            isInShownMonth={isCalendarDayInMonth(dayKey, shownMonthKey)}\n                            isToday={dayKey === todayDayKey}\n                            isSelected={dayKey === selectedDayKey}\n                            title={formatCalendarDayTitle(dayKey, locale)}\n                            onSelect={selectDay}\n                        />\n                    )),\n                )}\n            </div>\n\n            <WorkshopCalendarLegend />\n\n            <div className=\"mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2\">\n                <h3 className=\"text-sm font-bold capitalize text-white\">{shownListingsTitle}</h3>\n                {selectedDayKey !== null && (\n                    <button\n                        type=\"button\"\n                        onClick={() => setSelectedDayKey(null)}\n                        className=\"text-xs font-semibold text-cyan-200 transition hover:text-cyan-100\"\n                    >\n                        {CALENDAR_MONTH_COPY.wholeMonthLabel}\n                    </button>\n                )}\n            </div>\n\n            {shownListings.length === 0 ? (\n                <p className=\"mt-2 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-white/15 bg-white/[0.025] px-4 py-4 text-sm text-slate-400\">\n                    {CALENDAR_MONTH_COPY.emptyMonthMessage}\n                </p>\n            ) : (\n                <WorkshopEventCardList\n                    listings={shownListings}\n                    locale={locale}\n                    timeZone={timeZone}\n                    className=\"mt-2\"\n                />\n            )}\n        </div>\n    );\n}\n","numLines":191,"startLine":1,"totalLines":191}}}

Když během pár minut nedorazí, zkontroluj spam a Hromadné.',\n44\t        },\n45\t        {\n46\t            icon: BellRing,\n47\t            title: 'Den předem ti pošleme připomínku',\n48\t            description: 'Ať ti workshop nezapadne mezi schůzky.',\n49\t        },\n50\t        {\n51\t            icon: Video,\n52\t            title: `${durationLabel} živě`,\n53\t            description: 'Projdeme celé workflow od issue po merge na reálném repu. Na konci bude čas na tvoje otázky.',\n54\t        },\n55\t    ] as const;\n56\t}\n57\t\n58\t/**\n59\t * Page confirming a finished registration for the online workshop\n60\t *\n61\t * Note: It lives const dateLabel = formatCzechWorkshopDate(workshop.startsAt);\n70\t    const timeLabel = formatCzechWorkshopTime(workshop.startsAt);\n71\t    const durationLabel = '@/components/ui/button';\nimport { AI_SUPERVIZE_MINI_PATH } from '@/lib/discounts/discountPlaces';\nimport {\n    createWorkshopCalendarEvent,\n    createWorkshopCalendarFileName,\n} from '@/lib/workshops/workshopCalendar';\nimport {\n    createWorkshopParticipantLink,\n    type WorkshopParticipantIdentity,\n} from '@/lib/workshops/workshopParticipantLink';\nimport {\n    formatCzechWorkshopDate,\n    formatCzechWorkshopDuration,\n    formatCzechWorkshopTime,\n} from '@/lib/workshops/workshopDate';\nimport type { WorkshopDetails } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopTypes';\nimport jiriJahn from '@/public/people/jiri-jahn-transparent-square.png';\nimport pavolHejny from '@/public/people/pavol-hejny-transparent-square.png';\nimport { finished\n *\n * Note: The campaign can optimize either on this event or on a conversion defined by the url of this page - the pixel\n *       reports both, so the choice stays in the Meta administration.\n */\nconst REGISTRATION_META_PIXEL_EVENT_NAME = 'CompleteRegistration';\n\nfunction createNextSteps(durationLabel: string) {\n    return [\n        {\n            icon: Mail,\n            title: 'Potvrzovací e-mail přijde za chvíli',\n            description:\n                'V e-mailu najdeš odkaz na připojení. Když během pár minut nedorazí, zkontroluj spam a Hromadné.',\n        },\n        {\n            icon: BellRing,\n            title: 'Den předem ti pošleme připomínku',\n            description: 'Ať ti workshop nezapadne mezi schůzky.',\n        },\n        {\n            icon: Video,\n            title: `${durationLabel} živě`,\n            description: 'Projdeme celé workflow od issue po merge na reálném repu. Na konci bude čas na tvoje otázky.',\n        },\n    ] as const;\n}\n\n/**\n * Page confirming a finished registration for the online workshop\n *\n * Note: It lives on its own url, so that an ad campaign can optimize on real registrations instead of clicks.\n */\ntype OnlineWorkshopThankYouPageProps = {\n    readonly workshop: WorkshopDetails;\n    readonly participantIdentity: WorkshopParticipantIdentity;\n};\n\nexport function OnlineWorkshopThankYouPage({ workshop, participantIdentity }: OnlineWorkshopThankYouPageProps) {\n    const dateLabel = formatCzechWorkshopDate(workshop.startsAt);\n    const timeLabel = formatCzechWorkshopTime(workshop.startsAt);\n    const durationLabel = formatCzechWorkshopDuration(workshop.startsAt, workshop.endsAt);\n    const nextSteps = createNextSteps(durationLabel);\n    const participantLink = createWorkshopParticipantLink(\n        ONLINE_WORKSHOP_PARTICIPANT_PATH,\n        participantIdentity,\n        workshop.slug,\n    );\n    const calendarEvent = createWorkshopCalendarEvent({\n        occurrence: workshop,\n        hostFullname: ONLINE_WORKSHOP_HOST_FULLNAME,\n        participantIdentity,\n        participantPath: ONLINE_WORKSHOP_PARTICIPANT_PATH,\n    });\n\n    return (\n        <div className=\"flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-white\">\n            <WorkshopParticipantOfflineSupport />\n            <MetaPixelEvent eventName={REGISTRATION_META_PIXEL_EVENT_NAME} />\n\n            <MinimalHeader />\n\n            <main className=\"flex flex-1 items-center justify-center px-6 py-12 md:py-20\">\n                <div className=\"w-full max-w-2xl text-center\">\n                    <div className=\"mx-auto mb-8 flex h-20 w-20 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-cyan-50 to-teal-50 ring-8 ring-cyan-50/50\">\n                        <CheckCircle2 className=\"h-10 w-10 text-cyan-600\" />\n                    </div>\n\n                    <h1 className=\"mb-4 text-[32px] font-extrabold tracking-tight text-[#0f172a] sm:text-[40px] leading-tight\">\n                        Máš rezervované místo na workshopu: {workshop.title}.\n                    </h1>\n                    <p className=\"mx-auto mb-10 max-w-lg text-[16px] leading-relaxed text-gray-500 sm:text-[18px]\">\n                        Uvidíme se {dateLabel} v {timeLabel} online. Registrace je hotová.\n                    </p>\n\n                    {participantLink && (\n                        <div className=\"mx-auto mb-10 max-w-md rounded-2xl border border-cyan-100 bg-gradient-to-br from-cyan-50 to-teal-50 p-6 text-left\">\n                            <h2 className=\"text-[15px] font-bold text-[#0f172a]\">Připojení najdeš i tady</h2>\n                            <p className=\"mt-1 text-[14px] leading-relaxed text-gray-500\">\n                                Kdyby potvrzovací e-mail zapadl ve spamu, do místnosti se připojíš rovnou tady.\n                            </p>\n                            <Button\n                                asChild\n                                className=\"mt-4 h-11 rounded-full bg-promptbook-blue-dark px-5 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-promptbook-blue-dark/90\"\n                            >\n                                <Link href={participantLink}>\n                                    Připojit se k workshopu\n                                    <ArrowRight className=\"ml-2 h-4 w-4\" />\n                                </Link>\n                            </Button>\n                        </div>","numLines":120,"startLine":1,"totalLines":208}}}

compact card needs less width than a comfortable one, so a surface which offers its terms quietly fits one\n *       more of them into a row instead of merely making each of them shorter.\n */\nconst EVENT_TERM_OPTION_LIST_DENSITIES: Readonly<Record<EventTermDensity, string>> = {\n    comfortable: 'gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2',\n    compact: 'gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3',\n};\n\ntype EventTermOptionListProps = {\n    readonly terms: readonly EventOccurrence[];\n\n    /**\n     * The one term of this event which is chosen right now, which may well be listed somewhere else than here\n     */\n    readonly selectedTermSlug: string;\n    readonly onSelectTerm: (term: EventOccurrence) => void;\n\n    /**\n     * Icon and text of the one line this surface adds about each of its terms, see `EventTermOptionCard`\n     */\n    readonly noteIcon: LucideIcon;\n    readonly createNoteText: (term: EventOccurrence) => string;\n    readonly isTopicShown?: boolean;\n    readonly appearance?: EventTermAppearance;\n\n    /**\n     * How much room each of these terms is given, see `EVENT_TERM_OPTION_LIST_DENSITIES`\n     */\n    readonly density?: EventTermDensity;\n    readonly offered in the same grid whether they are being registered for or entered. event.slug,\n            );\n\n            if (workshopAvailability === null) {\n                return `kapacita na ${eventDayLabel} se ověřuje`;\n            }\n\n            if
